rules.name: Roaming Performers
rules.description:
You may add one of the following Harlequins units to your Army List:
● TROUPE MASTER
● SHADOWSEER
and one of either:
● LIGHT TROUPE
● DARK TROUPE
● TWILIGHT TROUPE
If you do add one or more of those units to your Army List, your Army Rules gains Mocking Misstep, Allegro Advance, Prismatic Pirouette and Kaleidoscopic Cavalcade.

rules.name: Black Guardians’ Webway
rules.description: After this unit is Activated in reserves, you may use ‘webway’. If you do, roll 3D6. Then, Deploy this unit anywhere on the battlefield at least X” away from all enemy units where X is the result of that roll. If you do, during this turn’s Move step, do not make a Move roll and this unit cannot Advance or Reposition.

rules.name: Pathfinders
rules.description: For each ranged attack this unit makes, ignore negative modifiers to the Hit Roll and reroll a failed Wound Roll of 1 for that attack.
